# Kaenz

> Skip the traffic. Travel by yacht. Kaenz is an end-to-end platform for Commute, Tour, and Special Occasion yacht trips in marinas and ports worldwide. Independent owners, captains, and marinas run each trip. Kaenz is not a charter operator.

Kaenz is the yacht platform at https://kaenz.com, operated by Salvazion, Inc. (a Delaware corporation). An algorithm sets the price from trip type, duration, yacht type, guests, and date. Payment is Stripe. Languages: English, Spanish, French, Italian, and Portuguese. Tagline in Spanish: Salta el tráfico. Viaja en yate.

## Product

- [Home](https://kaenz.com/): Commute, Tour, and Special Occasion
- [Yachts](https://kaenz.com/fleet): private, captained yachts
- [Join](https://kaenz.com/join): owners and captains list a yacht
- [Sign up](https://kaenz.com/signup)
- [Log in](https://kaenz.com/login)
